Written September 24, 2026
Thanh Lich Hospitality
Cher Monsieur Yves,

Nous vous adressons nos salutations chaleureuses de la part de La Paix Bistro !

Nous vous remercions sincèrement d’avoir pris le temps de partager votre agréable expérience lors de votre repas parmi nous. Nous sommes ravis de savoir que vous avez apprécié notre cuisine, notamment la bruschetta en entrée ainsi que la belle pièce de viande à partager.

Nous sommes particulièrement touchés par vos gentils compliments à l’égard de Ngan. Sa gentillesse, sa sympathie et son attention envers nos clients sont très appréciées, et nous ne manquerons pas de lui transmettre vos chaleureux remerciements.

Nous sommes également heureux que vous recommandiez La Paix Bistro pour une expérience culinaire d’inspiration française à Huế. Votre recommandation est une belle source d’encouragement pour toute notre équipe.

Merci encore d’avoir choisi La Paix Bistro. Nous espérons avoir le plaisir de vous accueillir à nouveau lors de votre prochain séjour à Huế pour partager avec vous d’autres moments gourmands et agréables.

Nous vous souhaitons une excellente santé, beaucoup de bonheur et de merveilleux voyages à venir.

Cordialement,
Yen Chi (Mme) / Responsable E-commerce
Pour Nhat Khanh (M.) / Director of Products & Sales

Cảm ơn Quý khách đã lựa chọn La Paix Bistro. Chúng tôi rất mong sớm được chào đón Quý khách trở lại và tiếp tục mang đến những trải nghiệm ẩm thực thật dễ chịu trong lần ghé thăm tiếp theo.

La paix bistro made our Tuesday dinner the highlight after a dreary wet September rainy day!
Sep 2026 • Family
Ngan the supervising leader was most helpful and friendly offering assistance and good service. Our meal was pleasant and the steak was done to medium with wholegrain mustard sauce. And the pizza was fresh and very satisfying. We had a nice meal and the jsm compote accompany the bread as starter was really tasty and good. Truly a pleasant nice dinner for our small group of 4 la
Insider tip:
Nice restaurant - good service and great friendly staff

Thanh Lich Hospitality
Dear Explore42266069334,

Warm greetings from La Paix Bistro!

Thank you very much for taking the time to share such a lovely and detailed review of your Tuesday dinner with us. We are delighted to know that your evening at La Paix Bistro brought a little warmth and enjoyment after a rainy day in Hue.

It is wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the medium-cooked steak with wholegrain mustard sauce, our fresh and satisfying pizza, as well as the delicious compote served with your bread starter. We are especially grateful for your kind words about Ngan, our supervising leader. Thank you once again for choosing La Paix Bistro. We sincerely hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you and your friends back to Hue for many more memorable dining moments in the future.
